tilesIntersectingArea.method: WFS BAG3D:tiles, bbox = area + 50 m in EPSG:28992

used.rule: centroid inside the 2.8 km square; height = lod12_2d b3_h_70p minus pand b3_h_maaiveld (NAP); multi-part buildings one row per part; sha256 of each .gpkg.gz verified against the WFS tile index
used.rdToWgs84: pyproj default operation "Inverse of RD New + Amersfoort to WGS 84 (4)", stated accuracy 1 m; "(3)" differs by 5 mm at the centre; no grid-based RDNAPTRANS2018 operation is offered by the local PROJ 9.8.1 database even with the network enabled
used.downloadNote: the server sets Content-Encoding: gzip on the .gz files; requests must read raw bytes (decode_content=False) or the published sha256 never matches

sources.role: terrain DTM and DSM (Task A6; DSM for guard G5)
sources.name: Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland (AHN) WCS, PDOK / Rijkswaterstaat
sources.nativeCrs: EPSG:28992 (RD New), 0.5 m, values in metres above NAP
sources.epoch: The service abstract says: 'Het huidige AHN is versie 4. Deze versie is ingewonnen over de jaren 2020, 2021 en 2022.' So the WCS serves AHN4 (2020-2022), NOT AHN5 (2023). 3D BAG heights for this area come mostly from AHN5 (2023). Guard G5 therefore compares across a 1-3 year vintage gap.

sources.licence: CC0 1.0 (for the AHN4 coverage served here)

result.note: _sentinel.py picks the lowest-cloud scene per month, at most 6 a year, among scenes with the sun at least 40 degrees up (STAC view:sun_elevation; Area.min_sun_elevation_deg). 30 candidates 2021-25 passed the cloud filter, 10 of them with the sun below 25 degrees (Jan, Feb, Nov, down to 14.5): L2A has no shadow correction, so those darken a canyon city's per-cell median (Amsterdam audit F5). The 40 degree floor keeps 28 of 30 candidates; 27 were readable.
